info.title: Catalog Hub transactional core
info.description: Actual new core routes. organizationId is resolved from the credential, never selected by the caller. Legacy UI/AI/import routes are outside this document. Writes require confirmation and/or expected versions as described. JSON is bounded to 1 MiB and depth 30. All responses include X-Request-Id. Real channel delivery/cutover requires a separate verified pilot.

get.description: active=true returns only confirmed QUEUED/RUNNING tasks, oldest first. Other lists show newest first. Up to 50 tasks; active capacity is limited to 10. payloadBytes counts the UTF-8 size of the PostgreSQL JSONB text representation of source payloads.

post.summary: Create private UPLOADING run; no product is changed
post.description: Tenant capacity: 10 active tasks, 20000 reserved source rows, 64 MiB of active JSONB payloads. A task reserves its full expectedRows until it finishes, fails or is canceled. Concurrent enqueue and explicit retry use the same organization quota lock. No stock change.

post.summary: Upload one immutable source chunk
post.description: At most 100 rows per chunk; each compact input payload is at most 60000 UTF-8 bytes. Stored JSONB text is counted atomically in payloadBytes: at most 32 MiB per task and 64 MiB across active tasks. Overflow rolls back the entire chunk. Retrying a successful idempotency key never charges bytes twice.

Consume a signed OWN_STORE event
post.description: API key must be tenant-bound. A channel-bound orders:write:{id} credential is accepted only here. HMAC-SHA256 signs timestamp + "." + connectionId + "." + canonical JSON of the original body. Send x-catalog-timestamp (Unix seconds) and x-catalog-signature (v1=hex). Freshness: +/- 300 seconds. Item identities use mapped sellerSku and externalWarehouseId. Production ACTIVE remains gated by pilot release.

post.summary: Compare an operator-provided snapshot without remote writes
Change mode with expectedVersion; PRODUCTION ACTIVE is blocked
Confirm exact manifest; incomplete runs cannot execute
Apply at most limit (1..100) rows with atomic per-row checkpoints
post.description: At most 100 rows or 10 seconds per call. Each business change and its row checkpoint commit together. A busy task is skipped using SKIP LOCKED; another worker can process a different task. Lost responses or stopped workers resume from durable checkpoints without duplicate application.

post.summary: Stop remaining work; requires confirmed and expectedVersion
Explicitly retry errors up to three attempts; versions rechecked
post.description: Explicit retry of failed rows rechecks both row and payload capacity before reactivating the task. Existing version, confirmation, idempotency and three-attempt limits continue to apply.

post.summary: Claim outbox events with 60-second lease
post.description: At most 100 current leases per organization across all workers. Concurrent claim keys share a quota lock. An exhausted capacity returns an empty events array. Response also includes inFlight and remainingCapacity. Expired leases with fewer than 8 attempts can be reclaimed with a new token; an expired eighth attempt becomes DEAD. Claiming is not proof of external delivery.

post.summary: Reserve stock with a unique business reference
post.description: Atomic across all items. Duplicate product/warehouse pairs are combined and require identical expectedRevision. A reference is unique per organization; a retry with equivalent normalized reference, reason and quantities returns the current reservation, even after completion. Reusing it for different content is a 409. Stock revisions are preconditions, not business identity. No expiry or automatic release.

get.summary: Read one standalone reservation

post.summary: Release standalone reservation items
post.description: All actions require confirmation, a reason, expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key. Omitting items applies all eligible quantities; otherwise only selected product/warehouse pairs change. Release/ship use remaining=quantity-released-shipped. Return uses returnable=shipped-returned and restores onHand without creating a new reservation. Returns are allowed while other items remain reserved. One transaction changes counters, Inventory, StockMovement, version and outbox. Release also works for an inactive warehouse; shipment and return require an active warehouse.

get.summary: Read active import capacity and tasks with no progress for five minutes
Read tenant-scoped outbox backlog, expired leases and in-flight capacity
Read recipient settings, status counts and 20 deliveries; no secret values

post.summary: Configure recipient with confirmation and expected version
post.description: At most 10 configured recipients per organization. Default UI state is PAUSED. ACTIVE requires an active OWN_STORE TEST connection and a configured CATALOG_DELIVERY_SECRET_* (at least 32 characters). Production activation remains blocked. Changing URL, secretRef or topics increments generation, cancels unfinished old deliveries and queues one fresh channel.refresh_requested invalidation. State-only pause/resume preserves queued work. Only future events are routed; creation adds an explicit refresh. In-flight requests cannot be recalled.

get.summary: Read recipient delivery status without raw source payloads or signatures

post.summary: Lease eligible per-recipient deliveries
post.description: Up to 100 active external-delivery leases per organization. Lease is 60 seconds, at most 8 attempts. Only active TEST OWN_STORE connections and ACTIVE current-generation recipients are eligible. Returns items containing immutable DeliveryEnvelope, destination URL, secretRef name, leaseToken and leaseUntil. Official worker claims one job at a time. An expired eighth lease becomes DEAD. OutboxEvent and OutboxDelivery have independent consumption state.

post.summary: Complete only with a verified signed durable-inbox receipt
post.description: Checks current lease, target generation, deliveryId, eventId, connectionId, canonical envelope SHA-256 and HMAC receipt within 300 seconds. HTTP 200 alone cannot complete a delivery. Stored receipt means durable inbox receipt, not offer publication. Signature domain: catalog-delivery-ack-v1 + newline + timestamp + newline + canonical JSON of ack.

post.summary: Record bounded failure and backoff for the current lease
Explicit version-guarded retry of a DEAD delivery
